title: Runtime Gate Decision Schema v2.2.0
description: JSON Schema v2.2.0 compatible with the frozen Runtime Gate Decision Contract v2.2.0. Encodes FailureCode subsets (Fail/Blocked/Inconclusive/HumanReviewRequired) per Section 14.2, failure_code compatibility with outcome at all signal and GateDecision layers, GateDecision fail recommendation limited to stop_stage/stop_run/human_intervention/proceed_with_warning (proceed and more_evidence rejected), plus all frozen Gate Decision v2.2.0 constraints: pass independently forbids failure_code/failure_description, pass/fail non-empty evidence, recommendation constrained by outcome, degradation_note for non-full execution_mode, failure_description canonical templates, PreviousDecisionSnapshot $ref reuse, prior_evidence_ids empty array support. Validator initial and reevaluation requests require evidence_envelope.validation_report. Semantic-only: report_ref identity comparison, prior evidence ID detection, error code first-match precedence, failure code admissibility for (outcome, evidence_classification) determined by evaluator, exact verdict preservation.

ArtifactRef.description: Typed artifact reference. Required fields: artifact_id, artifact_kind.

artifact_kind.description: Closed enumeration of artifact kinds relevant to gate decision contract.

artifact_version.description: Optional semantic version of the artifact.

RunContext.description: Minimal run context carrying run_id and stage_id.

OverrideAuthorization.description: Override authorization record. All fields non-empty.

GateDeclaration.description: Gate declaration shape. required flag, allow_gate_override (conditional), gate_type enum, failure_behavior enum, contract_ref (conditional for validator gate_type).

GateEvidenceEnvelope.description: Evidence package with classification, primary/supporting evidence, and optional validation_report.

missing_evidence_description.description: Required when evidence_classification is not complete.

PreviousDecisionSnapshot.description: Minimal immutable snapshot of a prior GateDecision for re-evaluation. Reuses complete GateDecision schema constraints through $ref. GateDecision.additionalProperties:false already prevents extra properties.

EvaluationSignalValidator.description: Evaluation signal for gate_type: validator. report_ref and overall_verdict required. failure_code conditional.

EvaluationSignalArtifactShape.description: Evaluation signal for gate_type: artifact_shape. outcome (pass/fail) and artifact_ref required. failure_code conditional.

EvaluationSignalDiffReview.description: Evaluation signal for gate_type: diff_review. outcome (pass/fail) and diff_ref required. failure_code conditional.

EvaluationSignalCustom.description: Evaluation signal for gate_type: custom. outcome (5 values) and custom_source_ref required. failure_code conditional.

GateEvaluationRequest.description: Discriminated union on request_kind. Base fields shared; branch-specific fields enforced by oneOf variants.

GateEvaluationRequestInitial.description: Initial evaluation branch: request_kind=initial. evidence_envelope, evaluation_signal, execution_mode required. Signal shape discriminated by gate_type.

GateEvaluationRequestReevaluation.description: Re-evaluation branch: request_kind=reevaluation. evidence_envelope, evaluation_signal, previous_decision_snapshot, prior_evidence_ids required. Signal shape discriminated by gate_type.

GateEvaluationRequestOverride.description: Override branch: request_kind=override. override_authorization and previous_decision required. evidence_envelope, evaluation_signal, execution_mode forbidden.

GateDecision.description: Gate decision output shape. All 14 fields with exact types. failure_code and failure_description conditional on outcome != pass.

failure_code.description: Required when outcome != pass. Must be a value from the closed FailureCode enumeration.

failure_description.const: Independent Validator could not be dispatched or reached.
Validator was dispatched but no report was produced.
Required evidence artifact is missing but recoverable.
Required Validation Contract could not be resolved.
Required gate cannot proceed due to unavailable dependency.
Execution mode degraded below the correctness threshold.
Required evidence artifact does not exist and cannot be produced.
Evidence from two or more independent sources contradicts.
Validation Contract is present but insufficient for a deterministic verdict.
Gate requires a judgment the evaluation system cannot make.
Validator used candidate output as truth source with no resolution path.
Required evidence artifact does not exist and cannot be produced. Human review required.
Evidence from two or more independent sources contradicts. Human review required.
Validation Contract is present but insufficient for a deterministic verdict. Human review required.
Gate requires a judgment the evaluation system cannot make. Human review required.
Validator used candidate output as truth source with no resolution path. Human review required.

GateEvaluationError.description: Error output shape. decision_id, gate_id, run_context accept null. error_code from closed 12-value taxonomy. error_description always present.

decision_id.description: Copied from request when present and valid. null when unextractable.

gate_id.description: Copied from gate_declaration when present and valid. null when missing or malformed.

run_context.description: Copied from request when present and valid. null when unextractable.

FailureCode.description: Closed enumeration of all admissible failure codes per the frozen Gate Decision Contract v2.2.0 Section 14.1.

FailureCodeFail.description: Failure codes admissible for fail outcome per Section 14.2. Exactly ONE code maps to fail.

FailureCodeBlocked.description: Failure codes admissible for blocked outcome. 6 codes.

FailureCodeInconclusive.description: Failure codes admissible for inconclusive outcome. 5 codes.

FailureCodeHumanReviewRequired.description: Failure codes admissible for human_review_required outcome. 5 codes.

FailureCodeNonPass.description: All 16 failure codes admissible for non-pass outcomes.
